AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Animal Feed: Hay? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Storage of Crop Produce? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Storage of Crop Produce.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Storage of Crop Produce.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Storage of Crop Produce.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Storage of Crop Produce.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
